pr_title: Fix metadata _size when it comes to stored fields extraction
pr_body:
Corrects weird regression introduced in: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/91269

Previous to that change, getting `_size` worked when using `storedFields`. However, that change now detects if a field type declares itself as `stored`. Even though `_size` is stored, it didn't declare itself as such. 

This change fixes that.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/94468
pr_comments: Hi @benwtrent, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

issue_context.title: Mapper-Size Plugin Does Not Work on 8.6.2
issue_context.body:
### Elasticsearch Version

8.6.2

### Installed Plugins

mapper-size

### Java Version

_bundled_

### OS Version

3.10.0-1160.83.1.el7.x86_64

### Problem Description

Elastic mapper-size plugin fails on version 8.6.2 with updated templates for global, index, and component (both custom and managed).  It does work in 8.5.0

### Steps to Reproduce

Enable plugin, enable _size field, ingest data

**Works in 8.5.0 though!**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11168913/224351648-5184f1df-0579-4d53-a7a1-97230570a1d5.png)

comments:
8.6.0 is where the mapper-size plugin breaks
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11168913/224359322-29d31e50-0714-4a3d-9c52-6d1a63c4c4cc.png)
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11168913/224359423-ab0a0410-fcab-47e3-ad10-b1a81d8a0e97.png)

@iamhowardtheduck I just deployed an 8.6.2 cluster, and was able to get the `_size` field without an issue. However, I did have to specify `"fields": ["_size"]`. 

Kibana Discover, etc. use `fields: [*]` there might be a regression where we skip including `_size` when `fields: [*]` is provided. Digging deeper.
Ah, I have narrowed it down to `"stored_fields": ["*"]` being changed between the versions.
